hook_sub: a DAY: New York's fine for selling an AI chatbot toy
beats: New York just banned toys with built-in AI chatbots for 5 years.
Why? A watchdog tested chatbot toys for kids aged 3 to 12.
Some talked about sexually explicit topics. The ban starts in 90 days.
